analysis: frozen V10.1 secondary oracle and prefix scaling

definitions.candidate_order: locked candidate index order, seeds 1000 through 1031
definitions.sample_oracle: lowest TPF sample; ties use MeanER then candidate index
definitions.baseline_inclusive_oracle: lowest TPF among baseline and prefix samples; ties use MeanER then baseline/index
definitions.meaner_guarded_oracle: baseline-inclusive oracle restricted to samples with MeanER <= baseline + 0.50
definitions.metric: TPF = missed exact explicit-tuplet GT notes + onset-error events on matched exact explicit-tuplet GT notes

n32_diagnosis.interpretation_rule: Good oracle candidates with poor V10 picks indicate a selection bottleneck; absence of good oracle candidates indicates a sampling/generation bottleneck.
